rationale: The ready/valid storage is single-clock synchronous and every non-reset input and output in the stream interface has explicit minimum and maximum delays.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the stream register to a 16-bit ready/valid stage with synchronous clear.

mutation.description: The output data register is not rewritten when valid is low, but its valid bit still defines when the data is meaningful.
